title: Introduce inference price-ladder autotuner (tenant-tiered batching & quant presets)
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: Customers frequently ask for automated defaults that pick batching/caching and quantization presets per tenant while respecting spend ceilings and latency SLOs. This PR adds a price-ladder autotuner: a runtime component + CLI tooling that synthesizes a small set of tiered defaults (bronze/silver/gold) per tenant. Each tier encodes a pipeline of preferences (batch target, prefix cache policy, quant profile preference, and fallback order). The autotuner derives tiers by replaying a brief synthetic workload (sampled request shapes), scoring candidate presets by unit-econ (tokens/cost) and 95th-percentile latency. Design summary: 1) price_ladder service (go): orchestration for running quick simulations, emitting candidate tier manifests; 2) price-ladder CLI (ts): dry-run, apply, export as presets-as-code; 3) config schema updates: TenantDefaults API gains price_ladder field and tier manifests; 4) runtime hooks: small decision point in route selection to prefer tier-specific presets and fall back gracefully; 5) telemetry: new telemetry keys price_ladder.run_id and pricing_metrics.{tier}. Outcome: default generator produces conservative tiers that improve unit-econ by ~18% on our benchmark trace while keeping p95 latency within SLO (<= 120ms) for silver/gold tiers. Rollout: feature gated behind feature_flag.price_ladder and initially enabled for internal tenants. See checklist below.

review_comments: Ethan Marlow: Nice end-to-end. Please add a comment about safety margin used during simulation (we don't want aggressive quant that breaks hallucination rate).

Priya Natarajan: Added safety_margin parameter documented in synth_replay.go and exposed via CLI flag --safety-margin (default 0.12). Also added a unit test asserting chosen quant profiles are not lower than tenant_min_quant when set.
Diego Alvarez: Can we avoid running heavy synthetic replays in the hot path? Make sure the service uses permissive CPU/GPU quotas and a single-shot worker per tenant.

Priya Natarajan: Generator is async and scoped to a short-lived worker. The route hook uses only the previously computed manifest; if no manifest exists we fall back to system defaults. Clarified in main.go comments.
Zara Kim: Add e2e assertion for p95 latency with the price ladder applied. Also check telemetry contains run_id for every apply.
Priya Natarajan: Added integration test that validates p95 <= 120ms for silver/gold under our benchmark trace and verifies telemetry.record contains price_ladder.run_id.

merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-02-20 by Zara Kim. Commit message consolidated to: 'price-ladder: autotune tenant-tiered batching/caching/quant presets; add CLI and telemetry'. Backwards compatible: TenantDefaults schema adds optional price_ladder field. Migration writes empty manifests for existing tenants. Feature gated behind feature_flag.price_ladder.
release_notes: Add price-ladder autotuner: generate tenant tier manifests that recommend batching, cache, and quant presets to optimize unit economics while respecting latency SLOs. Feature off by default; enable via feature_flag.price_ladder. CLI: price-ladder dry-run/apply/export. See docs/platform/price-ladder.md for details.
deployment_plan: 1) Deploy service to staging; 2) Run price-ladder dry-run against sampled internal tenant traces; 3) Review candidate manifests via console; 4) Enable feature_flag for internal tenants; 5) Monitor pricing_metrics and latency p95 for 48h; 6) Gradually expose to opt-in customers; 7) After stabilization, enable rollout automation
testing_notes: Integration tests include synthetic replay harness, p95 assertions, and telemetry verification. Bench numbers: on benchmark-trace-v3, silver tier reduced token-cost by 18% with p95 latency +8ms (within target). Added regression test to prevent quant profile regressions when tenant_min_quant is present.
observability_changes: New metrics: price_ladder.replay_duration_ms, price_ladder.candidate_score, pricing_metrics.{tier}.unit_cost_estimate, pricing_metrics.{tier}.p95_latency_ms. Added tracing span 'price-ladder.generate' and run_id propagated as baggage. Metric dashboards added under Console -> Cost Optimization -> Price Ladder.
security_considerations: Autotuner runs only on sampled traffic and does not persist raw request payloads. All generated manifests are stored encrypted at rest. Access to apply manifests gated by RBAC (role: infra:price_ladder_apply).
notes: This PR focuses on safe defaults and auditability. Follow-ups: 1) automate tenant opt-in heuristics; 2) expose recommended presets via SDK; 3) support cross-tenant compare mode for marketplace customers.
